title: Penthouse Magazine October 1979 Back-to-School Issue Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Vintage 1979 issue. Covers bright with light edge wear; some toning and light wear on the back cover and along the spine. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, October 1979 - Back-to-School Issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: The Great Cancer Fraud; The 20 Worst College Football Teams; Hazing 1979; Spies on Campus; Trouble at the Air Force Academy; Illiteracy Among the Faculty.

Back cover: Carlton cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
